title: Member of room can't send messages

labels.name: X-Needs-Info
labels.description: This issue is blocked awaiting information from the reporter

body:
### Description

Member of room can't send messages
Other members don't see him as a member

### Steps to reproduce

I have created a room with two members(m1, m2) + me.
m1 received two invites(accepted both of them). One of room was without members - m1 left it
m1 can't write messages he receives errors.
m2 and me can't see him in the room

### Homeserver

private server from synapse container

### Synapse Version

1.63.1

### Installation Method

Docker (matrixdotorg/synapse)

### Platform

-hardware
-vm

### Relevant log output
